_description: Data-fetching routes that render no loading, empty or error state. Measured at a committed revision, never against a dirty tree. These counts only shrink: a new route must ship all three states, and closing an old gap lowers the ceiling for everyone after you.
_measuredAt: fc62f20d4f17aadd8169b95c3d499dcbcfab45a4. Every count was taken on a clean checkout of that commit with this lane applied and nothing else, so no other lane's uncommitted work is baked in; each number sits exactly at its ceiling with no headroom.
